name: ideate
description: Standalone ideation stage. A free-form jam with an Opus thinking partner, grounded read-only in the repo: no skills, no structured questioning, no steering towards a plan. Only if the human asks, the jam writes the idea up as docs/ideas/<slug>.md from the shared idea-doc skeleton. A script then names the branch, commits the doc, and the finish step pushes the branch and records the ideate entry in the pipeline manifest. A jam that ends without a doc fails the stage with "no idea doc written".
author: arbitron

inputs.name: repo_url
inputs.description: Repo to clone and talk about. The jam reads it; only the idea doc is ever written.

inputs.name: base_branch
inputs.description: Branch the worktree is cut from (detached). The new dev-<slug>-<date>-<short> branch starts here, and it is recorded as the manifest's base_branch.

inputs.name: topic
inputs.description: What to talk about. Empty opens the jam with "Okay, what are we talking about?".

inputs.name: teams_webhook_url
inputs.description: Teams webhook URL, accepted for parity with the other stages. Leave empty in the committed sample.

nodes.label: Init workspace
nodes.description: Clone base_branch and add a detached worktree at ./work. No branch exists until the jam produces a slug.

nodes.label: Promote vars
nodes.description: Lift work_dir and run_date to top-level vars for the jam and finalize.

nodes.label: Jam
nodes.description: Open-ended ideation with the human. On request only, writes docs/ideas/<slug>.md and <workspace>/.arbitron/ideate-result.json, then commits locally. No outputSchema: the human ends the session and the slug travels through the result file.

nodes.label: Finalize idea
nodes.description: Check the result file, the kebab-case slug and the doc; fail with "no idea doc written" when the jam produced none. Move the worktree onto dev-<slug>-<run_date>-<short_id> and commit the doc if needed. Deterministic, so it halts instead of retrying.

nodes.label: Promote result
nodes.description: Lift slug and branch to top-level vars, where manifest-append reads them.

nodes.label: Record stage
nodes.description: Push the new branch, then commit and push the ideate entry to .arbitron/pipeline/<slug>.json. Its outputs are the stage contract.
